title: 6-ஆம் அதிபதி மற்றும் நோய்கள் (6th Lord Disease Mapping)
description: Sun: Head, hair fall, right eye, spine. Moon: Mental stress, left eye, cold, allergies. Mars: Blood, bone marrow, surgery, teeth. Mercury: Skin, ENT, shoulder nerves. Jupiter: Obesity, diabetes, liver, brain. Venus: Uterus, kidneys, hormonal. Saturn: Leg pain, chronic/mobility. Rahu/Ketu: Tumors, psychiatric, poisoning.

title: நோய் எப்போது குணமாகும்? (Disease Recovery Timing)
description: Disease persists in Dasa where Dasa Lord's dispositor connects with 6th lord and Saturn. In upcoming Dasa where this contact ceases, complete cure is attained.

title: சிறுநீரக கல் நோய் (Kidney Stones Indication)
description: Venus + Moon + Saturn mutual connection produces kidney stones, urinary calculi, and renal discomfort.

title: பக்கவாதம் மற்றும் நரம்பு பிரச்சனை (Paralysis / Nerve Disorders)
description: Mercury + Ketu connection with Saturn aspect leads to facial paralysis, hemiplegia, or central nerve afflictions.

title: விபத்து மற்றும் ஆயுள் கண்டம் (Accidents & Life Danger)
description: Afflicted 8th lord / Lagna lord connecting with Mars + Rahu indicates fire or vehicle accidents. Moon + Venus + Rahu indicates poisoning or suicidal ideation.
